CustomField.description: When checked, the daily, weekly and monthly digest batches send nothing for this neighbourhood (boundary Account) and log a Skipped row instead. Checked by default so a new neighbourhood stays quiet until it launches; uncheck to start digests. Independent of Active__c, which controls signup routing.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Checked by default so new neighbourhoods stay quiet. Uncheck when the neighbourhood launches to start digest emails. Signups still route here if Active is Yes.
CustomField.label: Pause Digest Emails
